name: How long does a typical pool deck remodeling project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical pool deck remodeling project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a pool deck remodeling project varies based on its scope, material choice, and the size of the deck. A smaller project involving resurfacing might take a few days, while a complete demolition and new installation of a larger deck can take two to four weeks. Factors like weather conditions, material availability, and unforeseen repairs to the underlying structure can also influence the timeline. Your contractor will provide a more accurate estimate after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical pool deck remodel can take anywhere from a few days for resurfacing to two to four weeks for a full demolition and new installation, depending on the project's scope and materials.
